notes: Literature rate configuration for warpcoeff_v3 fitclasses. Rates are local volumetric rates unless rate_kind indicates a parent fraction. Derived rates are resolved by the adapter from parent rates and fractions. Entries marked missing_direct_rate are intentionally not silently estimated. Absolute-magnitude priors are stored separately under magabs_priors. Their source_band records the literature band; sncosmo_band records the band used by set_source_peakabsmag. No color or band conversion is silently applied.
